says: exam-paths.json lists the glob apps/fabrika/e2e.ts three times, each with a different why, so the list reads longer than it is and a reader cannot tell which why is current.
proof: grep -n '"apps/fabrika/e2e.ts"' exam-paths.json on 59cb6a311 prints lines 34, 43 and 92, each with glob apps/fabrika/e2e.ts.
cost: Small: dropping one of the three rows looks like removing an exam path when it is not, and the loosening read has to work that out by hand.
